facts.fact: The Countdown analysis says DHIS2 holds the DRC's routine health facility reporting, 2019-2024, with reporting completeness reaching 99% in 2024.
The analysis says public primary-level facilities offering the minimum package report essential indicators more reliably in DHIS2.
The Countdown analysis says DHIS2 data on facility reporting across the DRC's health zones and districts cover 2019-2024 and are of generally high quality.
The analysis gives DHIS2 reporting completeness rising to 99% in 2024, with about 90% for six key indicators.

COD.note: Nothing on national standards for information technology or data.
